Title: Azure Active Directory support in Azure Database for PostgreSQL—single server now available

Body.Content:
The Azure Active Directory integration for Azure Database for PostgreSQL–single server is now generally available. Use this integration to securely sign in to your database using Azure Active Directory and manage credentials in a central place. For consistent role management, manage database access using Active Directory groups, as well as Active Directory applications.

For more information, see the service documentation.
